WITH TOP_APPM_NBR AS (
	SELECT
		DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY APPM_NBR ORDER BY APPM_NBR DESC, APPM_CURRENT_STEP DESC, APPM_DELTA_DATE DESC) AS DR
		,APPM_NBR
		,APPM_PRIN_APPM_NBR
		,APPM_PRIN_CARD_NBR
		,APPM_CUST_NBR
		,APPM_ACCT_NBR
		,APPM_CARD_NBR
		,APPM_CIF_NBR
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXAPPMP CEA
), GRT_PROD_VARIANT AS (
	SELECT TOP 1 *
	FROM BUSC.CCD_GENREFTABLES
	WHERE DATA_MART_FIELD = 'PROD_VARIANT'
), GRT_DECLINE_REASON AS (
	SELECT *
	FROM BUSC.CCD_GENREFTABLES
	WHERE DATA_MART_FIELD = 'DECLINE_REASON'
), GRT_DEVIATION_REASON AS (
	SELECT *
	FROM BUSC.CCD_GENREFTABLES
	WHERE DATA_MART_FIELD = 'DEVIATION_REASON'
)
INSERT INTO DW.DMYearToDateApplication
(
 STATUS
,PROD_VARIANT
,DATE_STATUS
,APP_DATE
,APPM_DATE_INPUT
,APPM_NBR
,APPM_PDT_NBR
,APPM_CURRENT_STEP
,APPM_ACC_DCL_IND
,APPM_GEMP_ZIP
,APPM_FORMAT_ID
,APPM_DATE_MAINT
,APPM_PRIN_FNAME
,APPM_PRIN_MNAME
,APPM_PRIN_LNAME
,APPM_DELTA_DATE
,PGM_CODE
,MAIN_SALES_CHNL
,SUB_PGM_CODE
,BRANCH_CODE
,DD_TAG
,AGENT_CODE
,DECLINE_REASON
,DECLINE_CODE
,REF_NAME
,ACCT_CRLIMIT
,CUSTOMER_NAME
,CARD_IND
,YR_STATUS
,MON_STATUS
,CNT
,AREA
,REGION
,REGION_1
,BRANCH_NAME
,SALES_OFFICER
,APPM_MONTH
,APPM_YEAR
,APPM_GEMP_ADDR2
,DATE_TRANSMITTED
,DEV_REASON
,APPM_DATE_INPUT2
,DATE_RECEIVED
,DEVIATION
,REPROCESSED_TAG
,WEEK_STATUS
,APPM_ASC_MONTH
,APPM_ASC_YEAR
,SUB_DECL_REASON
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
)
SELECT
	CASE
		WHEN CEA.APPM_ACC_DCL_IND IN ('A') THEN 'APPROVED'
		WHEN CEA.APPM_ACC_DCL_IND IN ('D') THEN 'DECLINED'
		ELSE 'PENDING'
	END AS STATUS
	,GPV.DESCRIPTION AS PROD_VARIANT
	,CEA.APPM_DELTA_DATE AS DATE_STATUS
	,GREATEST(CEA.APPM_DATE_MAINT, CEA.APPM_DELTA_DATE) AS APP_DATE
	,CEA.APPM_DATE_INPUT AS APPM_DATE_INPUT
	,CEA.APPM_NBR AS APPM_NBR
	,CEA.APPM_PDT_NBR AS APPM_PDT_NBR
	,CEA.APPM_CURRENT_STEP AS APPM_CURRENT_STEP
	,CEA.APPM_ACC_DCL_IND AS APPM_ACC_DCL_IND
	,CONVERT(NVARCHAR, CEA.APPM_GEMP_ZIP) AS APPM_GEMP_ZIP
	,CEA.APPM_FORMAT_ID AS APPM_FORMAT_ID
	,CEA.APPM_DATE_MAINT AS APPM_DATE_MAINT
	,CEA.APPM_PRIN_FNAME AS APPM_PRIN_FNAME
	,CEA.APPM_PRIN_MNAME AS APPM_PRIN_MNAME
	,CEA.APPM_PRIN_LNAME AS APPM_PRIN_LNAME
	,CEA.APPM_DELTA_DATE AS APPM_DELTA_DATE
	,SUBSTRING(CEA.APPM_SOURCE,1,3) AS PGM_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(CEA.APPM_SOURCE,4,3) AS MAIN_SALES_CHNL
	,SUBSTRING(CEA.APPM_SOURCE,17,4) AS SUB_PGM_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(CEA.APPM_SOURCE,7,4) AS BRANCH_CODE
	,CASE
		WHEN CHARINDEX('DD', CEA.APPM_GEMP_ZIP) > 0 THEN 1
		ELSE 0
	END AS DD_TAG
	,CEA.APPM_AGENT_CODE AS AGENT_CODE
	,CASE
		WHEN CEA.APPM_ACC_DCL_IND IN ('D') THEN GDR.DESCRIPTION
		ELSE ''
    END AS DECLINE_REASON
	,CONVERT(NVARCHAR, COMPRESS(CEA.APPM_GEMP_ZIP)) AS DECLINE_CODE
	,CEA.APPM_REF_NAME AS REF_NAME
	,CEA.APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT AS ACCT_CRLIMIT
	,CEA.APPM_LOCAL_NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME
	,CEA.APPM_CARD_IND AS CARD_IND
	,YEAR(CEA.APPM_DELTA_DATE) AS YR_STATUS
	,MONTH(CEA.APPM_DELTA_DATE) AS MON_STATUS
	,TAN.APPM_NBR AS CNT
	,BC.AREA_CODE AS Area
	,BC.REGION_CODE AS Region
	,BC.REGION AS Region_1
	,BC.BRANCH_NAME AS BRANCH_NAME
	,CASE
		WHEN SUBSTRING(CEA.APPM_SOURCE,4,3) IN ('DEV', 'CBG') THEN 'OTHERS'
		WHEN SUBSTRING(CEA.APPM_SOURCE,4,3) = 'CBS' AND SUBSTRING(CEA.APPM_SOURCE, 17, 4) = 'TST1' THEN 'BERNA'
		WHEN CEA.APPM_DELTA_DATE < '2022-05-01' AND SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE, 17, 4) IN ('0PRV', 'TST1') THEN 'BERNA'
		WHEN SUBSTRING(CEA.APPM_SOURCE,4,3) NOT IN ('RBB', 'CBS') THEN 'SAM'
		WHEN SUBSTRING(CEA.APPM_SOURCE,4,3) IN ('TEL') THEN 'BERNA'
		WHEN SUBSTRING(CEA.APPM_SOURCE,4,3) IN ('DEV', 'CBG') THEN 'OTHERS'
		WHEN SUBSTRING(CEA.APPM_SOURCE,4,3) IN ('SMP') THEN 'MYRA'
		WHEN SO.SALES_OFFICER = '' THEN 'SAM'
		ELSE SO.SALES_OFFICER
	END AS SALES_OFFICER
	,MONTH(CEA.APPM_DATE_INPUT) AS APPM_MONTH
	,YEAR(CEA.APPM_DATE_INPUT) AS APPM_YEAR
	,CEA.APPM_GEMP_ADDR2 AS APPM_GEMP_ADDR2
	,CEA.APPM_PORA_BPLACE AS DATE_TRANSMITTED
	,CASE
		WHEN CEA.APPM_ACC_DCL_IND IN ('A') THEN GDVR.DESCRIPTION
		ELSE ''
	END AS DEV_REASON
	,CASE
		WHEN CEA.APPM_INPUT_OPERATOR = 'BATCH UPLD' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, CEA.APPM_DATE_INPUT)
		ELSE CEA.APPM_DATE_INPUT
	END AS APPM_DATE_INPUT2
	,CEA.APPM_PORA_CUR_ADDR AS DATE_RECEIVED
	,CASE
		WHEN CHARINDEX('DD',APPM_GEMP_ZIP) > 0 THEN 'Y'
		ELSE 'N'
	END AS DEVIATION
	,CASE
		WHEN SUBSTRING(CEA.APPM_GEMP_ADDR2, 1, 2) = 20 THEN 1 
		ELSE 0
	END AS REPROCESSED_TAG
	,DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, CEA.APPM_DELTA_DATE) AS WEEK_STATUS
	,MONTH(APPM_DATE_INPUT) AS APPM_ASC_MONTH
	,YEAR(APPM_DATE_INPUT) AS APPM_ASC_YEAR
	,CASE
		WHEN CEA.APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' AND CEA.APPM_GEMP_ZIP = 'IC' AND CEA.APPM_PAST_DUE = '' THEN 'Applicant has no TU record at all or OBC CL<25K'
		WHEN CEA.APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' AND CEA.APPM_GEMP_ZIP = 'IC' AND (CEA.APPM_EXT_ISSUER1 = 0013 AND CEA.APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD1 = 2)
			OR CEA.APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' AND CEA.APPM_GEMP_ZIP = 'IC' AND (CEA.APPM_EXT_ISSUER2 = 0013 AND CEA.APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD2 = 2)
			OR CEA.APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' AND CEA.APPM_GEMP_ZIP = 'IC' AND (CEA.APPM_EXT_ISSUER3 = 0013 AND CEA.APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD3 = 2) THEN 'The PNB card submitted is either non-existing, with findings, or does not meet the minimum OBC criteria'
		ELSE 'OBC Provided is Secured/Supplementary/Corporate/Prepaid/Debit or is Cancelled'
		END AS SUB_DECL_REASON
        ,'' as WORKFLOWID
        ,'' AS TASKRUNID
        ,GETDATE() AS INSERTDTTM
FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXAPPMP CEA

LEFT JOIN GRT_PROD_VARIANT GPV
ON CONVERT(NVARCHAR, CEA.APPM_PDT_NBR) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GPV.CODE)

LEFT JOIN GRT_DECLINE_REASON GDR
ON CEA.APPM_GEMP_ZIP = GDR.CODE
--CONVERT(NVARCHAR, CEA.APPM_GEMP_ZIP) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GDR.CODE)

LEFT JOIN GRT_DEVIATION_REASON GDVR
ON CEA.APPM_GEMP_ZIP = GDVR.CODE
--CONVERT(NVARCHAR, CEA.APPM_GEMP_ZIP) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GDVR.CODE)

LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_BRANCHCODES BC
ON SUBSTRING(CEA.APPM_SOURCE, 7, 4) = BC.BRANCHID

LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_SALESOFFICER SO
ON SUBSTRING(CEA.APPM_SOURCE, 7, 4) = SO.BRANCHID

LEFT JOIN TOP_APPM_NBR TAN
ON COALESCE(TAN.APPM_NBR,'') = COALESCE(CEA.APPM_NBR,'')
AND COALESCE(TAN.APPM_PRIN_APPM_NBR,'') = COALESCE(CEA.APPM_PRIN_APPM_NBR,'')
AND COALESCE(TAN.APPM_PRIN_CARD_NBR,'') = COALESCE(CEA.APPM_PRIN_CARD_NBR,'')
AND COALESCE(TAN.APPM_CUST_NBR,'') = COALESCE(CEA.APPM_CUST_NBR,'')
AND COALESCE(TAN.APPM_ACCT_NBR,'') = COALESCE(CEA.APPM_ACCT_NBR,'')
AND COALESCE(TAN.APPM_CARD_NBR,'') = COALESCE(CEA.APPM_CARD_NBR,'')
AND COALESCE(TAN.APPM_CIF_NBR,'') = COALESCE(CEA.APPM_CIF_NBR,'')
WHERE DR = 1
